notes: Record Now: one click records the screen along with the readings, saved picture by picture so it survives the crash. Step through what was on screen in the final seconds.
Restarts that were asked for: names the program that told Windows to restart (updater, installer, remote tool, script).
Network share crashes: shows the drivers on the crash stack, flags mup.sys, and names the outside drivers next to it.
System tab lists the file-system filter drivers (same as fltmc), with non-Windows ones marked.
